description: Create and edit interaction records including meetings, calls, emails, and other communications with partners and contacts. Supports AI transcription and file attachments.

pages.name: InteractionModalComponent
pages.description: This modal allows users to create new interaction records or edit existing ones. Interactions can include various types of communications like meetings, calls, and emails. It supports adding participants, uploading relevant documents, and leveraging AI for transcribing and extracting details from audio or image files.

buttons.label: Save | Create Interaction
buttons.description: Saves or creates an interaction record with all form data, including participants, documents, and interaction details.
when_to_use: When all required fields are filled and you want to save the interaction to the system

buttons.label: Delete
buttons.description: Permanently deletes an interaction record after a confirmation dialog. Use with caution as this action cannot be undone.
when_to_use: When an interaction was recorded incorrectly or is no longer relevant (use with caution)

buttons.label: Process Transcription
buttons.description: Processes AI transcription results from uploaded files (audio, image, or text) and automatically fills relevant form fields with extracted interaction data.
when_to_use: or text to extract interaction details automatically using AI

help_guidance.when_stuck: To create an interaction, ensure you fill in the interaction type (e.g., Meeting, Call), the date, and a subject. You can add participants by typing their email addresses or selecting existing contacts. For quick data entry, consider using the AI transcription feature to populate details from audio or image files.
common_tasks: Recording a meeting: Select 'Meeting' type, add the date/time, list all participants, and include detailed notes about the discussion.
Logging a phone call: Choose 'Phone Call' type, specify the contact, and summarize the conversation.
Adding participants: Type email addresses into the participant field or select from your contact list if they are already in the system.
Using AI transcription: After uploading an audio or image file, click the 'Process Transcription' button to automatically extract and populate interaction details.
Attaching documents: Use the document section to upload any relevant files, such as meeting agendas, notes, or contracts.
Setting follow-up: Add future interaction reminders or next steps to ensure continuity in your engagements.
help_guidance.getting_started: To get started, open the 'Create Interaction' modal. First, select the 'Type' of interaction (e.g., Meeting, Call). Then, enter the 'Date' and a brief 'Subject'. You can then add participants and any relevant notes or attachments. Click 'Save' to record your first interaction.
